title: 滚轮选择器
eyebrow: 连续拨动 · 基准吸附与圆柱透视
eyebrowEn: Continuous Flick · Baseline Snap & Cylinder Depth
summary: 有序离散数据或时间刻度，不要弹虚拟键盘也不要展开60项长列表。上下拨动连续滑动，松手依据滚动吸附中央基准线，离基准线越远透明度与尺寸沿圆柱面几何递减。
summaryEn: Ordered discrete values and time scales should never pop an obstructive soft keyboard or span an unscrollable 60-row list. Vertical flicking tracks continuously, release snaps to the central baseline, and peripheral items fade along a cylindrical perspective curve.
asks: 有序固定选项或时间刻度，这一格是用键盘输入、长列表展开，还是滚轮对齐基准线？
asksEn: When selecting ordered options or time units, should it be typed, expanded into a long list, or aligned via a wheel picker?

links.when: 滚轮选择器针对有序滚动吸附，不是下拉面板单选
links.whenEn: wheel picker is for ordered scroll-snap alignment, not a flat dropdown select

links.when: 滚轮选择器是移动端触控输入控件，不是桌面鼠标滚轮侧栏
links.whenEn: wheel picker is a mobile touch input control, not a desktop mouse wheel sidebar

links.when: 滚轮选择器设定时长后，再由计时器管理正数倒数会话
links.whenEn: wheel picker sets duration, then timer manages count-up/down

links.when: 滚轮吸附是内容滚动量化到基准线，不是抽屉容器高度吸附
links.whenEn: wheel snap is content scroll quantized to baseline, not container height snapping
